output.summary: This flowering mint is native to Europe, North Africa and the Middle East, though its native range is thought to centre on the eastern Mediterranean. Crushed leaves smell strongly of spearmint, and small mauve flowers form dense, widely spaced whorls along the stems.
output.edibilityNote: Historically used as a cooking herb and still used to flavour foods; pennyroyal is toxic, and its concentrated oil can be fatal if swallowed.
